scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,daemon,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @legible/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @legible/daemon" "npm run dev --workspace @legible/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @legible/shared && npm run build --workspace @legible/daemon && npm run build --workspace @legible/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
